limitations: Real WeChat collection still requires testing a user-selected conversation and a supported logged-in Windows WeChat installation.
Exporter is optional and external; automatic collection requires its own Python dependencies.
Synchronization polls complete snapshots rather than receiving live message pushes.
Only identified plain text is collected; interpreted self memories require separate confirmation.
No automatic style-profile training; redaction does not guarantee complete anonymization.
